## Checklist

- [ ] One logical change
- [ ] Tests cover the behaviour change, or this is not a behaviour change
- [ ] The design spec is updated in this PR if documented behaviour changed
- [ ] No unrelated reformatting

If this adds or changes a dependency:

- [ ] Stable release — no preview or prerelease
- [ ] Permissive licence with no fee or revenue trigger for commercial users
- [ ] Not deprecated and no known vulnerability on nuget.org
- [ ] Adds no cloud or identity vendor assumption
